statement: Let N be an s-t network on exactly 4 vertices with integer capacities. If N has exactly one minimum s-t cut, then N has exactly one maximum s-t flow.
definitions: An s-t network is a finite digraph on vertex set V with distinguished s != t, no loops or parallel arcs (antiparallel arcs allowed), and a nonnegative integer capacity on each arc. A flow is a function f from arcs to the nonnegative reals with f(a) <= cap(a) and flow conservation at every vertex other than s,t; two flows are distinct if they differ on some arc. An s-t cut is a vertex set S with s in S, t not in S; its capacity is the total capacity of arcs from S to V\S; a minimum cut is one of minimum capacity.
